description: This Java class `FixedDepositTransactionWorkbookPopulator` is responsible for generating and populating an Excel workbook specifically for fixed deposit transaction data import. It sets up sheet layouts, validation rules, default values, and references for related sheets within the import template, handling fixed deposit account data and transaction specifics within a broader Fineract platform context.

classes.name: FixedDepositTransactionWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating and populating an Excel workbook template for fixed deposit transactions, including setting sheet layouts, validation rules, default values, and named ranges.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to create and populate the workbook for fixed deposit transactions, invoking layout setup, data validation rules, defaults, and formatting.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default formula values in specific columns across rows in the sheet.

methods.name: setTextFormatStyle
methods.description: Applies text format styling to specified columns in the sheet.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation rules, such as dropdown lists and date constraints, for the sheet's columns.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Creates named ranges for dropdowns and data validation, linking data across sheets.

methods.name: populateSavingsTable
methods.description: Populates the sheet with savings account data, formatted and sorted accordingly.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Configures the sheet's header row, column widths, and labels.
